'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Nelson LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
